summary: Maintain durable phase files as a subordinate responsibility of phase-baseline after delivery-baseline acceptance; future phase files are not instantiated by default.

triggers: session_focus = phase_session_baseline and phase files are selected
accepted delivery baseline requires the next active PHASE-xx.md
phase coverage or sequencing must be repaired after delivery-baseline acceptance

produces_artifacts: _hirmos/system/delivery/<delivery-id>/phases/PHASE-xx.md for the next active phase only
